---
name: No-evidence eval must pass --no_evidence flag
description: No-evidence ablation evals MUST include --no_evidence in inference.py command; missing it causes prompt template mismatch and invalid results
type: feedback
originSessionId: 50207a7f-3eaa-41b3-9906-c0bda12ff440
---
No-evidence model evals must pass `--no_evidence` to BOTH `sft_trainer.py` (training) AND `inference.py` (eval). Missing it in eval causes the eval to use with-evidence prompt template on a model trained without evidence, producing garbage metrics.

**Why:** 2026-05-16 incident — 1.7B no-evidence eval produced Ign-F1=0.3786 (vs expected ~0.47), 8B eval also invalid. Both had to be killed and resubmitted. Director flagged as CRITICAL: "0.3786 是 prompt mismatch 导致的伪数据."

**How to apply:** When submitting no-evidence eval, verify command contains BOTH `--sft_adapter <no_evidence_adapter>` AND `--no_evidence`. Checklist before submit: (1) adapter path points to no-evidence checkpoint, (2) `--no_evidence` flag present, (3) output dir has `_v2` suffix if rerun.
